Paper folding helps you succeed in PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PAPER FOLDING

PART 1: Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91

What this means
In this part you learn to Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Paper folding” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Paper folding is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Paper folding” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Paper folding to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Appreciate paper folding for fun groups • Express their emotions as they display their work 91.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Paper folding from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Paper folding: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Paper folding?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

1. Know what Paper folding means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
